findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State in the demo-retirement story that `code_quality.md`'s front-matter `default:` must be flipped to `true` (the front-matter is the source of truth; index.json is regenerated) so that removing the `ticket-quality` demo leaves exactly one `default: true` reviewer and `default_reviewer_id()` does not raise.
evidence: operations.py:50-54: `for rid, rv in catalog.items(): if rv.default: return rid` ... `raise LLMError("no default reviewer is configured in the catalog")`
index.json line 2 `_generated_by`: index.json is GENERATED from prompt front-matter — editing index.json directly is not the source of truth.
code_quality.md:12 `default: false`; index.json:7 `"default": false` for code-quality vs index.json:84 `"default": true` for the ticket-quality demo being deleted.

ABSENCE: the plan names the end-state and the regenerate-index drift gate, but never states the required positive edit to `code_quality.md`'s front-matter `default:` flag; a drift gate confirms index.json matches front-matter but does not force code-quality to be marked default.
findings.finding: The catalog `default` flag is the enum/flag that `default_reviewer_id()` reads to pick the default reviewer, but the plan under-specifies how `code-quality` becomes the single default. The index.json is generated from prompt front-matter, where `code_quality.md` is currently `default: false` and the demo entry `ticket-quality` is the ONLY `default: true` entry. Deleting the demo without an explicit front-matter flip of `code_quality.md` to `default: true` (then regenerating) leaves zero defaults, so `default_reviewer_id()` raises `LLMError('no default reviewer is configured')`.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria, criterion 1 ('the catalog has exactly one default reviewer (`code-quality`)'); src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md:12; src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json:7,84; src/rebar/llm/operations.py:45-54
scenarios: After the demo retirement lands, any default-reviewer selection (review-workflow op operations.py:167, review_workflows.py:52, the completion gate) calls `default_reviewer_id()` with no entry marked default and raises LLMError.
The regenerate-index drift gate passes (index.json matches front-matter) yet the catalog has ZERO defaults, so criterion 1's 'exactly one default reviewer' is violated at runtime.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to criterion 1 / the demo story: 'Set `default: true` in `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md` front-matter (it is currently `false`) and regenerate `index.json`, so that after `ticket-quality` is deleted `code-quality` is the sole `default: true` entry and `default_reviewer_id()` returns it rather than raising.'
